title: AIAnalysis
description: Contract for the structured output returned by the local AI engine after analyzing a NormalizedAlert. This schema defines the interface only — no LLM is implemented in Phase 1.

status.description: Status of the AI analysis result.

summary_uz.description: Short summary of the security event in Uzbek language.
examples: Bir nechta muvaffaqiyatsiz autentifikatsiya urinishlari aniqlandi.

summary_ru.description: Short summary of the security event in Russian language.

why_it_matters.description: Explanation of the potential security significance of this event in English.
examples: Multiple failed login attempts may indicate a brute-force or credential stuffing attack targeting this host.

investigation_steps.description: Ordered list of recommended investigation actions for the SOC analyst.
examples: Verify if the target account was ultimately compromised.

limitations.description: Optional note about known limitations or low-confidence areas of this analysis.
examples: Analysis is based solely on alert metadata. Full log context was not available.
